note: Held tier-5 English Wikipedia compilation for the VBM Freccia. The registry marks primary_held false because the article is a secondary compilation. The infobox carries identity only, and the first-phase table carries the IFV column figures. It publishes the empty mass, the payload, the maximum gross vehicle weight, the overall length and width and the height with the turret, and describes an 8x8 vehicle. It publishes no ground clearance, no engine rating, no tyre size, no transmission, no torque and no grouser statement, so the entry is not runtime-ready.
